Name: Sitnah
Description: Sitnah, 'contention', was the second well Isaac's servants dug in the Gerar valley, over which the herdsmen of Gerar also strove, so Isaac named it for the strife and moved on.
BiblicalSignificance: Sitnah is the second of Isaac's disputed wells, between Esek and Rehoboth: contention before room was found.
